title: TaskDone
description: The payload of task.done/v1 (M1 slice plan §1 admission; D51; I22): an admitted task ended, terminally, as a candidate (M1(a)'s template variant: its review's go selected, merge inactive). It frees admission: the next task is admitted only once the admitted one is done. internal/authority admits it only under its task's id and project, by a live system actor at its event's time, of the admitted task.

as.description: What the task ended as: candidate, the only end of M1(a)'s template.
